Method, sources & limitations

Your entries are processed in this browser. No account, API key or payment is required. Optional saved readings stay on this device.

Our approach

Depth, with clarity.

Saju is a Korean tradition that interprets the year, month, day and hour of birth. This reader makes its calculations and interpretation limits visible.

It is a rule-based cultural reading, not an AI consultation or a scientifically validated forecast. It does not diagnose health conditions or determine financial or relationship outcomes.
